tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Indigo, the brand colour: headings, primary buttons, the AI band, the closing call to action and the footer. White (11.7:1) or navy-200 (8:1) text on it.

tokens.name: navy-hover
tokens.usage: Darker indigo: primary button hover, and the text on gold (8.8:1).

tokens.name: navy-50
tokens.usage: Lavender tint: icon tiles, hover backgrounds, the cool end of picture washes. navy icons on it read at 10:1.

tokens.name: navy-100
tokens.usage: Lavender, one step deeper: pressed and selected backgrounds.

tokens.name: navy-200
tokens.usage: Body text on navy bands (8:1).

tokens.name: navy-300
tokens.usage: Small print on navy (the footer's last line).

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Sunrise orange: the header and the band behind the hero card, and decorative accents. A ground, never text: white on it is only 2.6:1. Text on it is ink (5.8:1).

tokens.name: saffron-50
tokens.usage: Warm tint: the AI line, the eyebrow chip, the warm end of picture washes.

tokens.name: saffron-200
tokens.usage: Border of the AI line.

tokens.name: saffron-strong
tokens.usage: The saffron that carries white text: button fills and accent text on white or canvas (4.7:1 with white, 4.5:1 on canvas). Use saffron for decoration and highlight (the header, bands, picture washes, dots, bars) and saffron-strong where a person must read it or tap it. On saffron-50 use brown (saffron-strong is 4.3:1 there). Hover and pressed: brown.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sun gold: one highlight per view (the $0 badge, step numbers, the gold button on navy). Text on it is navy-hover.

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: Ember: accent text (eyebrows, the highlighted headline phrase, the closing promise). 6.1:1 on white, 5.6:1 on saffron-50.

tokens.name: brown-900
tokens.usage: Ember, deeper: accent text on gold or saffron-200.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Quiet section background (the partner promises) and window title bars.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Progress and bar tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of cards, sections and panels.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and the mobile menu.

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: Decorative borders: inputs and secondary buttons drawn inside pictures of the product. It is 1.4:1 on white, so a real control never uses it: use line-control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of real controls: text fields, selects, checkboxes, radios, and the off state of a switch (WCAG 1.4.11, 3:1 against the surface). 3.5:1 on white, 3.4:1 on canvas, 3.3:1 on ground and 3.1:1 on navy-50. The focus ring stays 2px navy.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas (14.7:1), white and ground; the header's text on saffron (5.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas and white: leads and lists. Not on saffron (only 4.6:1); use ink there.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on canvas (6.5:1) and white (6.7:1): card copy, captions, the logo's descriptor.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text that must still be read: hints, placeholders, timestamps, the count beside a label. 5.2:1 on white, 5.1:1 on canvas, 4.9:1 on ground, 4.6:1 on navy-50 and 4.7:1 on saffron-50. Not for text on line (4.1:1): use muted there. Never set text lighter than this.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards, the hero card, the logo tile on dark grounds, and text on navy.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ticks and check icons, always beside words (5.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: success-50
tokens.usage: Background of a success tile or pill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only, always with words.

tokens.name: danger-50
tokens.usage: Background of an error message.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings that need a look but do not stop the work: the icon, the rule and the title of a warning message, always beside words. 5.9:1 on white, 5.7:1 on canvas, 5.5:1 on warning-50. Not a fill for white text (use saffron-strong or brown).

tokens.name: warning-50
tokens.usage: Background of a warning message or pill.

tokens.name: warning-200
tokens.usage: Border of a warning message.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-50 (8.6:1) and on warning-200 (7.4:1).

tokens.name: mark-teal
tokens.usage: Logo only: the left of the ribbon W.

tokens.name: mark-blue
tokens.usage: Logo only: the middle of the ribbon W.

tokens.name: mark-green
tokens.usage: Logo only: the right of the ribbon W.

tokens.name: mark-deep-blue
tokens.usage: Logo only: the shadow under the left stroke.

tokens.name: mark-indigo
tokens.usage: Logo only: the fold under the right stroke (top).

tokens.name: mark-lavender
tokens.usage: Logo only: the fold under the right stroke (bottom).

tokens.name: mark-sun-top
tokens.usage: Logo only: the sun's upper colour.

tokens.name: mark-sun-bottom
tokens.usage: Logo only: the sun's lower colour.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Do more good. Weaver handles the operations.
styles.usage: The one hero headline per page. 36px on phones, 52px on tablets, 56px wide.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Every hour a volunteer spends on admin is an hour taken from the mission.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.sample: Pledges, payments and books that agree
styles.usage: Panel headings inside a section (the product tour). 24px on phones.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: If you ever want to leave, we'll help you go.
styles.usage: A single promise set apart, centred. 24px on phones.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: The treasurer leaves, and what they knew leaves too
styles.usage: Titles of cards (pains, promises, the three Weavers at 18px).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark in the logo lockup.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We take members, giving, events, classes and the books off your volunteers' plates.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or section heading. 17px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every payment lands on the right household and flows to your accounting.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: One record for every family, keeping the IDs your community already uses.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Ask Niva to compare this month with last month.
styles.usage: AI lines, picture labels, fine print. The smallest running text on a touch surface (the member app, the event-day app, the portal on a phone): captions are never smaller than this there. Labels of 11 to 13px are for dense desktop tables and toolbars only.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Large buttons (hero, closing call to action); 16px in standard buttons, 15px in the header.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The chip above a heading, set in capitals, brown on saffron-50.

styles.name: descriptor
styles.usage: The line under the wordmark in the logo lockup.

styles.name: ai-tag
styles.usage: The AI and Niva tags, in capitals.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Identifiers only: receipt, pledge, household and member numbers, codes, payer references. It keeps 0 and O, 1 and l apart. Never for running text, headings, buttons or numbers a person reads as an amount (amounts stay in Hanken Grotesk with tabular figures).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the container on phones.

tokens.name: gutter-wide
tokens.usage: Side padding of the container from tablets up.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on phones.

tokens.name: section-y-md
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on tablets.

tokens.name: section-y-lg
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on wide screens.

tokens.name: stack
tokens.usage: Space between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: stack-lg
tokens.usage: The same space from tablets up.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Inside padding of a card on phones.

tokens.name: card-pad-lg
tokens.usage: Inside padding of a card from tablets up.

tokens.name: hero-pad
tokens.usage: Inside padding of the hero card on wide screens (24px phones, 40px tablets).

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid on phones, and between an icon and its text.

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid from tablets up.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Smallest height and width of anything tapped on a touch surface (the member app, the event-day app, the portal on a phone): links, tabs, icon buttons, rows, switches. Smaller only where a mouse is the input.

tokens.name: control-primary
tokens.usage: A button's height: the one primary action of a page, every button on a phone, and the public website's buttons (56px in the hero).

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, fields and chips in dense mouse-driven tables and toolbars (the admin portal on a desktop). On a touch surface they grow to tap-target.

tokens.name: control-dense
tokens.usage: The smallest control: row actions inside a table or a card header, mouse only. 30px is never used on a touch surface.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, the eyebrow.

tokens.name: radius-band
tokens.usage: The navy closing call to action band (28px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: The hero card and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards: pains, promises, tour panels on phones.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Product pictures drawn in a window frame.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, FAQ rows, the AI line, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-logo-tile
tokens.usage: The white tile the mark sits on over dark grounds.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, selects, textareas, the search field's inner box, rows that look like fields and small panels inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: The AI tag.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Status tags and small labels (Refund, Membership, Sample data): a solid or tinted rectangle, white or ink text, with words.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: The hero card over the saffron band.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Product tour panels.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Product pictures in a window frame.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Drop-down menus from the header.

tokens.name: shadow-badge
tokens.usage: The $0 badge.
